  label 50, 64, "Round" floor(n / target) + 1 faint

Cheat meals, in the mint colours.

- cheat: just the time of each entry. Every entry also keeps when it was added.

program:
app "Money pie" chart plum
table spend amount money, kind pick Need|Want|Save = Need, note text?
let a = sum(spend.amount month where kind = Need)
let b = sum(spend.amount month where kind = Want)
let c = sum(spend.amount month where kind = Save)
let t = max(a + b + c, 1)
draw 100, 100 width 200
  arc 50, 50, 44, 0, 360 * a / t fill accent
  arc 50, 50, 44, 360 * a / t, 360 * (a + b) / t fill warn
  arc 50, 50, 44, 360 * (a + b) / t, 360 fill good
row gap 2
  "Needs" round(a * 100 / t) "%" bold color accent
  "Wants" round(b * 100 / t) "%" bold color warn
  "Savings" round(c * 100 / t) "%" bold color good
form spend
describe:
Money pie, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- spend: amount: money; kind: one of Need, Want, Save, starts at Need; note: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- a is the total amount of spend this month where kind is Need.
- b is the total amount of spend this month where kind is Want.
- c is the total amount of spend this month where kind is Save.
- t is the larger of a plus b plus c and 1.
Shows:
- a drawing made of arcs.
- text: "Needs", a times 100 divided by t rounded, "%".
- text: "Wants", b times 100 divided by t rounded, "%".
- text: "Savings", c times 100 divided by t rounded, "%".
- a form to add a spend.
hurried_style: a single sentence of 6 to 12 words, casual
fuller_style: two sentences, 20 to 35 words
order: start with the numbers or units

program:
app "Bakery" bread plum
table product name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 5, expires date?
let short = count(product, it.qty <= it.low)
short "products running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)
each product sort qty as i
  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
    stack grow
      i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
      "Expires" i.expires faint color if(i.expires < today, bad, muted)
    button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
form product
describe:
Bakery, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- product: name: text; qty: number, at least 0; low: number, at least 0, starts at 5; expires: date, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- short is how many of the product have its qty is at most its low.
Shows:
- text: short, "products running low".
- for each product sorted by qty:
  - a group; a tap opens the product for editing; a swipe removes the product, with undo:
    - text: the name of the product.
    - text: "Expires", the expires of the product.
    - a button "-"; a tap sets the qty of the product to the qty of the product minus 1.
    - text: the qty of the product.
    - a button "+"; a tap sets the qty of the product to the qty of the product plus 1.
- a form to add a product.

program:
app "Growth" chart mint
state pay money = 5000
state rate num = 10
state years num = 10
field pay "Saving each month"
"Yearly return %" rate faint
slider rate 0..30
"Years" years faint
slider years 1..30
let fv(y num) = if(rate = 0, pay * 12 * y, pay * (pow(1 + rate / 1200, 12 * y) - 1) / (rate / 1200))
"After" years "years" faint
(fv(years)) big
"You put in" (pay * 12 * years) faint
plot 0..years, 0..fv(years) axes
  each 1..years
    rect index + 0.15, 0, 0.7, fv(it) fill accent radius 2
    tick index + 0.5, it
describe:
Growth, in the mint colours.
Remembers while you use it: pay, starting at 5000; rate, starting at 10; years, starting at 10.
Shows:
- a box to fill in pay, labelled "Saving each month".
- text: "Yearly return %", rate.
- a slider for rate from 0 to 30.
- text: "Years", years.
- a slider for years from 1 to 30.
- text: "After", years, "years".
- text: pay times 12 times years when rate is 0, otherwise pay times the result of the pow of 1 plus rate divided by 1200 minus 1 divided by the result of rate divided by 1200.
- text: "You put in", the result of pay times 12 times years.
hurried_style: a short question, 4 to 10 words
fuller_style: three short sentences, 20 to 40 words
order: start with the problem or reason

program:
app "Ludo" dice ocean
table point team pick Red|Blue, pts num 1..500 = 1
let a = sum(point.pts where team = Red)
let b = sum(point.pts where team = Blue)
setting winat num = 50 "Play to"
row gap 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Red" bold
    a big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Red, pts = 1
  stack card grow align center
    "Blue" bold
    b big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Blue, pts = 1
button "Undo" tap remove last(point)
button "New game" tap remove all point
"Lead:" abs(a - b) faint
if a >= winat
  "Red win!" head color good
if b >= winat
  "Blue win!" head color good
list point
describe:
Ludo, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- point: team: one of Red, Blue; pts: number, 1 to 500, starts at 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Play to": number, starts at 50.
Works out:
- a is the total pts of point where team is Red.
- b is the total pts of point where team is Blue.
Shows:
- text: "Red".
- text: a.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Red, pts set to 1.
- text: "Blue".
- text: b.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Blue, pts set to 1.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest point entries, with undo.
- a button "New game"; a tap removes all point entries, with one undo.
- text: "Lead:", a minus b without its sign.
- if a is at least winat:
  - text: "Red win!".
- if b is at least winat:
  - text: "Blue win!".
- a list of point; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.

app "Daily Club accounts" users slate
table member name text
table fee member ref member, amount money

let spent = sum(expense.amount)

  stat income, "fees received"

  stat sum(expense.amount year), "expenses this year"

program:
app "Fitness Pro" run mint
table steps count num 0..
table workout kind text, mins num 1..300
table weigh kg num 20..300
table water ml num 1..5000
let w_now = last(weigh.kg)
sum(steps.count today) "steps today" big
sum(workout.mins week) "workout min this week," sum(water.ml today) "ml water today" head
form steps, "Add steps"
form workout, "Log workout"
form weigh, "Log weight"
quick water, ml, [250, 500]
trend weigh, it.kg
"Weekly summary" head
stack card gap 1
  if(sum(steps.count week) > sum(steps.count prev week), "Steps up", "Steps down or the same") "vs last week" color if(sum(steps.count week) > sum(steps.count prev week), good, warn)
  if(sum(workout.mins week) > sum(workout.mins prev week), "More workout minutes", "Fewer workout minutes") color if(sum(workout.mins week) > sum(workout.mins prev week), good, warn)
  if(sum(water.ml week) > sum(water.ml prev week), "More water", "Less water") color if(sum(water.ml week) > sum(water.ml prev week), good, warn)
  if(avg(weigh.kg week) < avg(weigh.kg prev week), "Weight down", "Weight not down") color if(avg(weigh.kg week) < avg(weigh.kg prev week), good, muted)
describe:
Fitness Pro, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- steps: count: number, at least 0. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- workout: kind: text; mins: number, 1 to 300. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- weigh: kg: number, 20 to 300. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- water: ml: number, 1 to 5000. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- w now is the latest kg of weigh.
Shows:
- text: the total count of steps today, "steps today".
- text: the total mins of workout this week, "workout min this week,", the total ml of water today, "ml water today".
- a form to add a steps.
- a form to add a workout.
- a form to add a weigh.
- one-tap buttons that add a water with ml set to each of 250, 500.
- a line chart of its kg over weigh.

program:
app "Budget" wallet slate
table spend what text, amount money, category pick Food|Bills|Travel|Fun|Health
state m date = today
let spent = sum(spend.amount month of m)
setting budget money = 80000 "Monthly budget"
screen main "Spend" wallet
  monthnav m
  if(spent > budget, "Over budget by", "Left to spend") abs(budget - spent) big
  goal spent, budget, "spent"
  "Safe to spend" round(max(budget - spent, 0) / (monthdays(today) - monthday(today) + 1)) "a day" faint
  form spend
screen charts "Charts" chart
  share spend month of m by category, sum(it.amount), it.key
  list spend month of m by day
describe:
Budget, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- spend: what: text; amount: money; category: one of Food, Bills, Travel, Fun, Health. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Monthly budget": money, starts at 80000.
Works out:
- spent is the total amount of spend in the month of m.
Remembers while you use it: m, starting at today.
Shows:
- a screen "Spend":
  - arrows that move m back and forward one month.
  - text: "Over budget by" when spent is more than budget, otherwise "Left to spend", budget minus spent without its sign.
  - spent out of budget with a progress bar, labelled "spent".
  - text: "Safe to spend", the larger of budget minus spent and 0 divided by the result of the number of days in the month of today minus the day of the month of today plus 1 rounded, "a day".
  - a form to add a spend.
- a screen "Charts":
  - bars that compare the total amount of the item across group of spend entries in the month of m by category.
  - a list of spend in the month of m by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
